Your Nearest Community Makerspace

Looking for a makerspace near Galesburg, MI?

Kalamazoo Makerspace is located just minutes from Galesburg at 219 Peekstok Dr in south central Kalamazoo. We're a community-run, nonprofit workshop where members share access to professional tools, equipment, and workspace for woodworking, metalworking, 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics, and more.

What You Can Do at Our Makerspace

  • Woodworking projects - Build furniture, cabinets, home improvements, and custom pieces
  • Metal fabrication & welding - Work with steel, aluminum, and other metals
  • 3D printing - Prototype products, create custom parts, and bring designs to life
  • Laser cutting & engraving - Cut and engrave wood, acrylic, leather, and more
  • Electronics & robotics - Build circuits, program microcontrollers, and create tech projects
  • Mixed-media projects - Combine multiple tools and techniques for complex builds

Why Galesburg Residents Choose Us

  • Close proximity - Just a short drive from Galesburg to south central Kalamazoo
  • Affordable membership - Much cheaper than buying and maintaining your own tools
  • Community support - Learn from experienced makers and collaborate on projects
  • Flexible access - Open evenings and weekends to fit your schedule
  • All skill levels welcome - From complete beginners to experienced craftspeople
  • Training included - Safety orientations and tool training provided

Convenient Location for Galesburg Residents

Our makerspace is located at 219 Peekstok Dr, Kalamazoo, MI 49001 - approximately 5 minutes from Galesburg via M-43 (Gull Road). We're easily accessible from anywhere in the Galesburg area, making it convenient to stop by after work or on weekends.

Whether you live in Galesburg proper, near Galesburg High School, or in the surrounding neighborhoods, Kalamazoo Makerspace is your closest full-service community workshop.

Available Workshops & Equipment

Wood Shop

Table saws, band saws, jointer, planer, sanders, hand tools, and workbenches

Metal Shop

Welders (MIG/TIG), metal lathe, mill, grinders, and metal fabrication tools

3D Printing Lab

Multiple 3D printers including large-format options for bigger projects

Laser Shop

Industrial laser cutters for precision cutting and engraving

Electronics Lab

Soldering stations, oscilloscopes, and electronics workbenches

Craft Room

Sewing machines, fabric tools, and space for fiber arts and crafts

How to Get Started

  1. Schedule a tour - Visit us to see the space and meet the community
  2. Choose a membership - Select a plan that fits your needs on our pricing page
  3. Complete orientation - Learn safety procedures and facility policies
  4. Get tool training - Receive training on the equipment you want to use
  5. Start making - Begin working on your projects with community support
Schedule a Tour View Pricing

Frequently Asked Questions

How far is Kalamazoo Makerspace from Galesburg?

We're located approximately 5 minutes from Galesburg via M-43 (Gull Road) at 219 Peekstok Dr in south central Kalamazoo. The drive is quick and convenient from anywhere in the Galesburg area.

Do I need experience to join?

No experience necessary! We welcome makers of all skill levels, from complete beginners to experienced craftspeople. We provide safety orientations and tool training to help you get started.

What does membership include?

Membership includes 56 hours a week of access to the facility (after orientation), use of all tools and equipment (after training), storage space for projects, and access to our community of makers. Check our pricing page for specific membership tiers.

Can I just pay per visit instead of a membership?

We operate on a membership model rather than day passes. This helps build a strong community and keeps costs affordable for regular users. Memberships start at very reasonable monthly rates.

Do you provide materials for projects?

Members bring their own materials (wood, metal, filament, etc.). We provide the tools, equipment, workspace, and expertise. Some consumables like sandpaper and basic hardware may be available.

What are your hours?

Members have 56 hours a week of access after completing orientation. For tours and general inquiries, check our calendar or contact us to schedule a visit.
